objective: Implement the dispatch-side serialized interruption decision and unclear-input behavior before streamer consumption
dispatch_flow: VAD start during assistant output emits internal pause and opens one 500 millisecond candidate
Meaningful non-filler interim STT emits TurnChange and starts the unclear-input watchdog after commit
Filler-only or empty ended speech emits internal continue at the deadline
Active speech at the deadline emits TurnChange
Additional meaningful interim extends the unclear-input watchdog
Usable non-empty final STT stops the unclear-input watchdog
Unclear-input expiry injects the configured prompt and never resumes old output

acceptance: Pause is emitted once on qualifying VAD start without context rotation
Meaningful interim commits TurnChange and starts unclear-input tracking
Filler-only interim does not commit and does not start unclear-input tracking
Ended unconfirmed overlap continues at 500 milliseconds
Usable final STT stops unclear-input tracking
Empty final STT does not suppress the configured unclear-input prompt
Unclear-input expiry cannot continue flushed output
The serialized owner closes each candidate once

streamer_slice.rule: Do not enable or release the dispatch slice until every configured streamer consumes pause, continue and flush

verification: just agent-finalize with exact changed paths
rollback: Revert the dispatch interruption slice and restore legacy VAD and unclear-input behavior.
